scientific_goal: Find an independently published simulation with nominal base cosmology closest to original CLASS h, omega_b, omega_cdm, n_s, m_ncdm, and document exactly which remaining physics and data-format gates still prevent adopting its halo trees for original E8 F0/F+/F− neutrino wake and eBOSS LRG×ELG 3pt. No simulation halo tree/catalogue or observed odd is read.

Primary z .8/1.1 and approximate secondary directory z .875/.95/1.025; actual secondary z MUST be read from the individual ASDF header. CompaSO L1 group mass N, SO threshold header SODensityL1 RELATIVE TO MEAN cosmic density and epoch dependent; no direct M200c inference. Bose et al. published merger trees for AbacusSummit CompaSO L1 halos, construction links across epochs; cleaned halo catalogs are not the same product as raw L1 and require declared choice.

Public data release and data products documented, but merger trees may require browsing via Globus and availability of exact box/product must be independently verified. No actual dataset file or header has been downloaded in this stage.

AbacusSummit nominal c000 cosmic parameter table, particle-based CDM-only N-body with smooth neutrino approximation and group catalog/merger trees. Public report is provenance, not individual eBOSS halo data.

numerical_diagnostic_only.percent_As_difference_report: 100*(exp(3.044)*1e-10/2.083e-9-1) numerical provenance mismatch, NOT an inferred change in galaxy B.
numerical_diagnostic_only.omega_ncdm_comparison: Do not certify original custom F+/F− omega_ncdm or Abacus background neutrino equivalence without an independently checked same-normalization header, original CLASS output and consistent F(q).
numerical_diagnostic_only.mass_ratio: Strictly do NOT convert CompaSO L1 N or SO_radius into M200c by relabeling; a separate validated 200rho_crit remeasurement from compatible particle data or a documented conversion profile at actual z is required.
numerical_diagnostic_only.cleaning: A tree cleaned mass history must use consistent cleaned/un-cleaned definition and exact merger branch; a cleaned halo catalog at z0 does not imply c200c(z) of same object.
numerical_diagnostic_only.neutrino_distribution: Original F0 thermal baseline matches only nominal massive species assumptions; original nonthermal F+/- is not present in Abacus c000 sim and must never be inferred from its merger-tree product.
